note.question: What relationships do a nonparametric joint assortment and price choice model represent?
note.overview: The selection of products and prices offered by a firm significantly impacts its profits. Existing approaches do not provide flexible models that capture the joint effect of assortment and price. The paper proposes a nonparametric framework in which each customer is represented by a particular price threshold and a particular preference list over the alternatives.
